title: 4 · Hex flange: 3D die fill from CAD
level: Intermediate · 3D · STEP import · ~40 s per run
summary: A round bar upset into a hexagonal head: a non-axisymmetric part that only a 3D model can predict.
instructions: 1. The STEP file holds three bodies: bottom die (with a shank pocket), bar, top die (hex pocket). The bar is recognised as the workpiece because its centre of gravity lies between the dies.
2. Press Solve. With Cut-away on, the section shows the material flowing up into the hex.
3. Watch the fill curve: the round head reaches the flats first; the hex corners fill last, when the load climbs steeply.
4. Use Ctrl+5 (top view) and the slider to watch the corners fill. F refits the view.
5. Run its multi-run over temperature and compare the final fill and peak load: corner fill is what limits the process.
